diagnostic_only.B01: Endpoint uncertain: no preset criterion and conflicting log/telemetry
diagnostic_only.B05: Deliberately interrupted; log dates inconsistent with telemetry

target: Hours to final acquisition of a documented completed test; measured timestamps, including interruptions
target_scale: Median completed training-bearing duration in hours, fixed per fold
primary_split: Eight leave-one-bearing-out folds; next bearing in sorted circular order for validation, following bearing for calibration; remaining five for fitting
training_weighting: Equal bearing contribution; stratified per-bearing sampling for neural models
primary_metric_weighting: Equal bearing contribution; window pooling secondary
calibration: 90th percentile absolute residual on separate calibration bearing; descriptive empirical intervals with no asset-level coverage guarantee

gate.G2: Same model late-life absolute-hour MAE below time-only baseline

gate_interpretation: G1-G3 must be met by at least one coherent learned predictor; G4 decides ranking-reversal versus ranking-instability framing. Thresholds unchanged from handoff. Normalized metrics and slopes are retrospective evaluation only.
selection: Frozen families/settings, epochs selected only by independent validation bearing. No target-bearing selection or future-history predictors.
maintenance_policy: First trigger when predicted remaining hours or lower bound is below 0.5, 1, or 2 h; one decision per bearing; failure cost ratio 5, 10, 20; always/never/age controls
claim_boundary: Ten available test-rig records; eight completed tests for prediction; seven multipart records excluded; no field-machine, universal zero-shot, or population coverage claim
registered_after: Initial corrected v2 trial and failed gate; expressly authorized by author before follow-up results
added_predictors: Current acquisition means T1,T2,ambient; max/difference/rise, causal 5-min EMA and running maximum; thermal 110 C margin, causal 15/30/60-min slopes; common vibration 6/8/10 g margins and prefix crossing counts. No held-out stopping-cause or per-test vibration-threshold input.
competing_stop: Two cause-specific Weibull residual-time landmark hazards with fixed shape 2; logged training stop cause event density, other cause survival, mean first-event time; coefficient penalty .1, intercept penalty .02 around log(2 median training lifetime); B01/B05 not fitted as censored events; only five independent fitting bearings per fold, missing-cause folds explicitly disclosed.
competing_threshold: Minimum thermal and vibration threshold-extrapolation control; thermal 110 C, vibration 8 g documented range midpoint, trailing .5 h slopes with .75 local/.25 positive source-median rate; first .1 h uses training-life clock; no threshold tuned to held-out data.
additional_analyses: Paired same-bearing v2/v3 error differences; stratify results by realized stopping type only after forecasts; temperature-only control; no extra data; no gate threshold change or selection of winning test seed.
follow_up_limit: One fixed endpoint-aware study. If unchanged G1-G3 fails, report failed follow-up and supply a bounded diagnostic revision draft, not a claim of reliable prognosis or submission readiness.
